crossRefs.note: Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee…
When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
“Now therefore arise, Yahweh God, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength. Let your priests, Yahweh…
“Yahweh God, don’t turn away the face of your anointed. Remember your loving kindnesses to David your servant.”
and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.

parallels.note: “Now therefore arise, Yahweh God, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength. Let your priests, Yahweh…

translations.web: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.
translations.bsb: Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
translations.kjv: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
translations.asv: Arise, O Jehovah, into thy resting-place; Thou, and the ark of thy strength.
